title: Right Analysis. Wrong Execution.
hook: The read was right. The trade wasn’t.

launchpad.outcome: Grade analysis, execution, risk and management separately, even when the trade reaches its target.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Was the analysis good? Was the trade good?

slides.kicker: Lesson 8 · Execution is its own skill
slides.headline: Same read. Two traders.
slides.line: Both read this long correctly. Both made money. Only one followed the plan.

options.label: Trader A
options.sub: Bought the push after the Continuation
options.say: That’s a chase. The plan was the retest.

options.label: Trader B
options.sub: Waited for the retest of the PIL
options.say: Yes. Same read, executed as planned.

slides.kicker: Lesson 8 · Execution is its own skill
slides.headline: Grade Trader A, one part at a time.
slides.do: Trader A: bought the push, used 3× normal size, moved the stop once. Hit a small win.

rows.label: Execution
rows.why: Chased instead of waiting for the retest.

rows.label: Management
rows.why: Moving the stop breaks the plan you set.

rows.label: Outcome
rows.why: A win, and it doesn’t fix the other four.

slides.after: Five separate grades. A win in one doesn’t erase the others.

slides.kicker: Lesson 8 · Execution is its own skill
slides.headline: Right about the market. Wrong about the trade.
slides.dayli: Being right about the market doesn’t erase being wrong about the execution.

takeaways: Analysis · execution · risk · management · outcome: five separate grades.
Right direction doesn’t erase a chase.
remember: Being right about the market does not erase being wrong about the execution.
